# Crafted Hertz - Audio DSP & Software Engineering Profile

## Company Profile & Identity
Crafted Hertz is an independent audio software company dedicated to developing premium VST3/AU plugins for modern electronic music producers. Founded by a veteran music producer and DSP engineer with roots in the electronic underground of 2001, the company bridges the gap between raw artistic intuition and surgical audio engineering. We reject cheap digital shortcuts, focusing instead on rock-solid C++ architecture, highly optimized CPU performance, and uncompromising sound quality.

## Flagship Products & Technology
Our software is built to empower producers with unparalleled sonic manipulation.
- **Resynth:** An advanced additive synthesizer driven by a powerful 320-partial engine. It features seamless drag-and-drop sample resynthesis, intelligent phase randomization for authentic analog warmth, Moog-modeled Zero-Delay Feedback (ZDF) filters, and an advanced stereo unison engine.

## Engineering & Design Philosophy
- **Core Technology:** Built from the ground up using modern C++ and the JUCE framework to ensure perfect DAW stability (Ableton, FL Studio, Cubase, Logic).
- **DSP Architecture:** Mathematically pure waveform generation, non-linear soft-clipping saturation (tube-style drive), and artifact-free audio processing.
- **UI/UX Aesthetic:** Dark "Tech Brutalism" style. Our fully resizable, responsive vector interfaces feature flat-topped hexagonal motifs, sleek dark zinc backgrounds, and precise Neon Lime accents, designed specifically for professional studio environments (with full Dark/Light mode support).
